dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire I was willing to pay, but volunteers were quick to give up seats when faced with possibility of sitting next to a solo 2yo

@dogecoin_empire Wife & I with our 2yo paid for our seats next to each other, delay caused us to miss the 2nd leg of our flight and all seats were separated. Luckily, found  generous people so that my wife could sit next to our 2yo.
